incompatibilities.title: Version detection: str2num(version(1)) mis-parses two-digit major version
incompatibilities.mechanism: version='24.1.0.2837808 (R2024a) Update 7'; version(1)='2'; str2num('2')=2. Code branches on ==4 (R4) and >=5/>5 (R5+). 2 matches neither -> error('unsupported matlab version') or wrong branch.
incompatibilities.impact: tfrview.m hard-errors -> breaks ALL TFR display -> root cause of ALL 6 demo failures (tfdemo1-6). Others silently take the R4 (legacy) or skip branches.

sites.severity: latent (vnum(1)=='5' false -> wrong contour arg order)

incompatibilities.fix: Replace fragile str2num(version(1)) with str2double(version) (e.g. 24.1) and make the R4-vs-R5+ branch always take the modern (>=5) path, since R4 is obsolete. Remove the now-dead R4 branches.

incompatibilities.title: Reserved keyword 'continue' used as an assignable variable
incompatibilities.mechanism: continue=0 / continue=1 uses the reserved word 'continue' as an LHS. R2024a raises MATLAB:m_invalid_lhs_of_assignment ('Incorrect use of = operator'). The whole file fails to parse.
incompatibilities.impact: tfrqview2.m is completely unloadable (exist=2 but call -> parse error at line 239). Not called by any demo, but a documented toolbox function.
incompatibilities.fix: Rename the variable (e.g. 'continue' -> 'cont') at all 3 sites.

incompatibilities.title: Non-integer array size: MATLAB:NonIntegerInput
incompatibilities.mechanism: R2024a enforces integer size arguments to ones/zeros. ones(1,N/2) with odd N (N/2=110.5) -> MATLAB:NonIntegerInput 'Size inputs must be integers'. Whole-valued doubles (110.0) are accepted.
incompatibilities.impact: gdpower(N,1) and anasing(N,t0,h) with h<=0 error for odd N; even N is fine.
incompatibilities.fix: Make sizing integer-safe: ones(1,round(N/2)) / zeros(1,round(N/2)), or restructure so the vector length is an explicit integer (and keep the y(2:N/2) index consistent). Confirm intended length for odd N against the k==1 group-delay definition.

incompatibilities.title: hist -> histogram
incompatibilities.fix: Replace hist(x,Nb) with histogram(x,Nb) (adjust output to counts if needed) or keep with a deprecation note.

incompatibilities.title: rand('uniform') legacy R4 state API
incompatibilities.mechanism: rand('uniform') errors in R2024a ('CLASSNAME argument must be a class that supports RAND'). Currently guarded by if MatlabVersion==4 (false), so never reached. Becomes live only if A1's version check is naively fixed to a modern branch that still routes here.
incompatibilities.fix: Delete the R4-only rand('uniform') call (and the dead R4 branch) when fixing A1. Use rng(...) if reproducibility is required.

incompatibilities.title: tfrview2.m declares function tfrview (name collision)
incompatibilities.mechanism: tfrview2.m line 1 is 'function tfrview(...)', so the file defines tfrview and collides with tfrview.m. checkcode: 'Function name tfrview is known to MATLAB by its file name: tfrview2'.
incompatibilities.impact: No callable tfrview2 exists; file shadows/conflicts. Nothing calls tfrview2 (verified).
incompatibilities.fix: Rename the function to tfrview2 (or the file). Decide intent: is tfrview2 a distinct API or a stale copy?

incompatibilities.title: 3 unit tests fail 20/20 (pre-existing, not R2024a regression)

detail.note: fmt/ifmt Mellin round-trip max_err=0.0285 > tol 1e-2; even pure-analytic fmconst gives 0.74; even N=120 gives 0.033. Accuracy/tolerance issue, no non-integer indexing in path.
PPAGED(ones window) vs PAGED asserted to sqrt(eps) (near-exact float equality) - too-strict tolerance.

incompatibilities.fix: Not a language fix. Either relax the tolerances to a numerically-justified bound or regenerate reference values. Flag for the 0.3 test suite.

incompatibilities.title: 5 unit tests fail intermittently (noisecg unseeded randn)
incompatibilities.note: All use noisecg (unseeded randn) with a fixed 5e-2 tolerance; outcome depends on the random realization.
incompatibilities.fix: Seed the RNG in the test (rng(fixed)) or use a stored reference noise vector; or widen the tolerance. Not an R2024a regression.
